implementationPlan.description: RED BASELINE / SHAPE TRACE. Before any owned edit, record `git status --porcelain` for all nine paths and the current HEAD anchor, then run the four-file focused Vitest reproduction standalone. Require the nonvacuous current count `Test Files 3 failed | 1 passed (4)` and `Tests 15 failed | 199 passed (214)` and record that the ten telemetry plus three launch-template failures are intercepted as `CLAUDE_LAUNCH_REQUEST_MALFORMED` at `LAUNCHER`, while the changed-request replay case incorrectly accepts. Also run `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` once as the pre-diff daemon baseline and preserve its exact failing test paths/count lines for final path attribution. Re-grep literal request-object expectations, exact key/count assertions, and the runner's 17-key roster; do not edit the runner or any store-composition path.

TESTS FIRST — LIVE FIXTURES AND REPLAY DIVERGENCE. Repair the shared request builders in activation-telemetry-launch.test.ts, activation-run-commit.test.ts, and launch-template-producer.test.ts to supply the exact live 17-key ClaudeLaunchRequest, including the sealed UTF-8 `renderedContext` and lowercase `contextManifestDigest`; each existing hostile test must then reach its intended later fence and continue asserting its exact REFUSED/NOT_ATTEMPTED/UNKNOWN code and refusing layer. Extend the real createFoundationAttemptService path in foundation-attempt-service.test.ts with a provider-run port that returns the same candidate launch record and counts calls/effects. Add (a) same key plus identical admitted request replay, (b) a nonempty generated mutation roster covering every one of the 17 top-level request data fields and each of the three serialized runtime scalar leaves, and (c) same request bytes plus a changed candidate record. Assert the generated denominator, exact `PROVIDER_RUN_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT` / `PROVIDER_RUN_LEDGER` / `storeCode: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT` for every changed-request arm, and exact `PROVIDER_RUN_REPLAY_DIVERGED` / `PROVIDER_RUN_LEDGER` for the record-only arm. The request-divergence fixture must hold key and candidate record byte-for-byte identical so no later record fence can answer first. Run no green gate yet; these new service arms must be red against identity.bytes.

MINIMUM IMPLEMENTATION — CANONICAL SEALED REQUEST IDENTITY. In foundation-attempt-contracts.ts, add a versioned deterministic byte encoder for the already-admitted ClaudeLaunchRequest returned by launchRequestBody. Its canonical projection must include all 17 request data fields and recursively stable JSON ordering, but replace `runtime` with exactly `{ installedRoot, pinRoot, quotedObservation }`; never traverse or serialize fs/facts/clock capability ports, and never mutate the frozen request. In foundation-attempt-service.ts, derive these bytes from `launchBody` after seal binding and runtime admission, then pass them as commitActivationProviderRun.requestBytes instead of pre-seal identity.bytes. Preserve commitActivationProviderRun, launchActivationProviderRun, produceLaunchTemplateFields, launchRequestBody, and every returned shape/signature/refusal vocabulary unchanged; activation-telemetry-launch.ts, activation-run-commit.ts, and launch-template-producer.ts are named reachability/typecheck sentinels and require no behavior edit. Keep every production file below 400 physical lines.

CONTRACT/TRUTH REVIEW. Review the complete nine-path diff against the measured shape consumers: corrected fixtures must use the live 17-key request rather than a local permissive facsimile; every existing telemetry assertion must still distinguish raw launcher code/layer from telemetry code/layer; same canonical bytes must replay without a second durable effect; changed canonical bytes must refuse before effects; and changed record with identical canonical bytes must remain the separate replay-diverged case. Confirm the encoder has an explicit version/domain, deterministic key ordering, no capability/secret serialization, and no changes to manifests, locks, store composition, runner parser, public response keys, binary bytes, or the old reason vocabulary.

ADVERSARIAL REVIEW AND MUTATION-RED DRILL. Run the adversarial-self-review checklist over the nine owned paths: twice/concurrent replay, revoked/throwing inputs, empty and maximum rendered context, UTF-8 preservation, changed manifest digest with unchanged text, every nullable launch field, and runtime capability objects. Before drilling, capture `git status --porcelain` for the exact mutated tracked paths. Temporarily mutate the production replay encoder to omit `contextManifestDigest` (or temporarily restore the service's `identity.bytes` call); run only the named changed-digest service assertion and require it to go red while the fixture keeps the same key and same candidate record, proving the production request-byte fence—not a downstream identical fence—is under test. Restore tracked bytes, prove restoration with an empty exact-path `git diff` against the pre-drill patch/hash, and rerun no other gate in this step. Treat a green mutant or zero generated cases as a finding to fix, never evidence.

FINAL VERIFICATION. From the restored tree, run exactly this 489-character shell:false foreground gate and record exit 0 plus nonzero Test Files/Tests lines: `node -e 'let{spawnSync:s}=require("child_process"),L=[["--filter","@moe/daemon","exec","vitest","run","--config=package.json","activation-telemetry-launch","activation-run-commit","launch-template-producer","foundation-attempt-service"],["--filter","@moe/daemon","typecheck"]];for(let a of L){let r=s("pnpm",a,{encoding:"utf8",shell:false}),o=r.stdout+r.stderr;console.log(o);if(r.status)process.exit(r.status);if(a[3]=="vitest"&&!/Test Files\s+[1-9][\s\S]*Tests\s+[1-9]/.test(o))throw 0}'`. Then run `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` standalone/unpiped at the delivered tree, require its nonzero count lines, compare its failing-path set with the step-1 pre-diff baseline, and permit completion only when the new-failure delta intersected with these nine owned paths is empty; disclose every foreign red line/path verbatim. Record physical line counts for all five production sources and confirm no daemon-store child path was touched.
